title: “Microsoft admin” needs a consent grant
scenario: A support engineer claiming to be from your cloud provider says a tenant issue requires temporary admin consent. They send a link that opens a genuine provider login page and asks you to approve a third-party application.

answers.A: Do not grant consent from the incoming link; verify the support case in the provider portal and involve your internal admin/security team.
answers.B: Ask the engineer to document the required permissions inside the official support ticket.
answers.C: Approve because the login page is genuinely hosted by the cloud provider.

explanation: OAuth consent can grant broad access through a real provider page. The app and support case—not the login screen—must be verified.
proTip: Real login page, potentially malicious app.
